title: Letter from Oliver Cowdery, 12 November 1830
source_note: Oliver Cowdery, Letter, Kirtland Township, OH, to “Our beloved brethren” [JS and others], [Fayette Township, Seneca Co., NY], 12 Nov. 1830. Featured version copied [ca. 1871] in Newel Knight, History, 207–210; unidentified handwriting; private possession. For more complete source information, see the source note for Letter to Newel Knight and the Church in Colesville, 28 August 1830.
